mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger central bank stimulus and fiscal support, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 4.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
